name: Mustapha Annouaoui
summary: Software developer building backend services with NestJS, PostgreSQL, and Kafka, alongside Flutter applications for iOS and Android. At Ora Technologies, my work spans payment services, internal tools, and the Kooul mobile app.
bullets: Built NestJS and PostgreSQL services for Ora Cash, including authentication, role-based access control, and transaction-related modules.
Developed backend features for the Ora Cash admin panel: audit logs, dashboards, exports, and wallet and transaction management.
Integrated APIs and messaging infrastructure using Kafka, with validation and monitoring to support service reliability.
Developed the Kooul Flutter app for iOS and Android, covering authentication, browsing, checkout, order management, and real-time tracking.
Integrated push notifications, analytics, remote configuration, maps, and secure local storage into mobile workflows.

projects.name: ft_transcendence
projects.summary: A multiplayer Pong game with chat and live notifications.
projects.detail: Led backend development: core APIs, JWT authentication, real-time sockets, and CI/CD with GitHub Actions.

projects.name: WebServ
projects.summary: An HTTP/1.1 server built from scratch in C++.
projects.detail: Built with a teammate, using non-blocking I/O and multiplexing for concurrent connections; supports CGI, chunked transfers, and keep-alive.

projects.name: Inception
projects.summary: A multi-service environment built with Docker Compose.
projects.detail: Orchestrated WordPress, Nginx, MariaDB, and Redis, with network configuration, container security, and service automation.
